findings.finding: An Ext-hit-only invalidation branch does not by itself prove no stale clean alias when Native Tag-hit writes/atomics, partial-sector native fills, host prefill, Base install or dirty promotion bypass that branch.
finite_coverage: Ext clean partial sector then missing-sector Native fill, later write/WB/reclaim/read
Native Tag-hit write/atomic while an alleged Ext alias is present: reject invariant violation, never silently serve stale data
Host/force-tag prefill after optional allocation rejected before mutation
Base dirty-promotion rebinding/ordinary install cannot create a duplicate Ext owner
findings.required: State and preserve Resident/Base/Ext single-owner invariant at every creator. Native Tag-hit must not use an uncharged Ext CAM for normal routing; verification-only assertions are different from functional lookup/repair.
findings.resolution: A acknowledged missing-sector paid invalidation and prefill rejection; Main to judge actual implementation/limited CPU evidence.

findings.boundary: Dropping a clean cached copy may be a legal policy effect; failure/backpressure must not acknowledge a request, refund an already spent port cycle, or leave an unsafe cached negative.
findings.finding: CLEAN does not imply four sectors ready. Returning native-miss while keeping an Ext entry live can leave an old-version alias.
findings.required: Reader/lease/generation/payload checks, reserve actual Ext write slot, invalidate/remove clean owner and release its exact handle before native allocation or safe same-handle alternative. Existing base WAD/landing/lower reservation remains before native enqueue.

findings.cost: Count epoch64 and query snapshot64 unless a real phase-union reuse is implemented; phase/segment/valid and any copied UID/address fields also count. Declare per-physical-tick maximum clients/updates; do not coalesce multiple same-tick creations across a query snapshot without a proven ordering rule.
findings.finding: A two-stage lookup must not consume a stale base-negative if a new Base owner appeared after the base query. A64-bit epoch is a real state/update contract, not a free global oracle.
findings.required: Cover commit_install and dirty-promotion address rebinding and every other new-owner creator. Recheck before consuming stage2/cached absence, or prove production ordering excludes mutation. Paid Base replay consumes the same shared query gate.

findings.finding: Main selected fixed RR indexed read/recheck/write, superseding the V1 LRU wording. This removes the need for a new free full128/256 row-state reduction, but still needs finite read and write resources.
not_allowed: single-call full256 functional find with a cosmetic2cycle delay
functional Ext same-address CAM on a Native Tag-hit without query payment
free all-row occupied/age/bank eligibility scans selecting a useful RR row
findings.required: One shared128-row address comparator gate for Base and Ext. Each base miss in modes1/2 pays second query; each epoch replay pays again. RR state read/recheck/write uses stated ports/cycles; if sharing existing Base views, show arbitration/backpressure; if extra, count them.
findings.topic: Shared query and RR indexed control ports

findings.finding: Same row/incarnation is necessary but not sufficient to treat an arbitrary number of logical updates as one free write.
findings.required: Freeze a finite operation matrix and maximum logical inputs per tick, legal lease/UID/sector/Payload/generation identities, exact read-modify-write result, and how two client requests arbitrate. Different rows HOLD; install/invalidate cannot silently merge with unrelated readers. Reserve before pin/response enqueue/bank service; cancellation does not refund physical grant.
findings.topic: One write port and same-row merge

findings.finding: CLEAN-only Ext, no WB_COMPLETE migration, original Base128/WAD128 and no cross-segment dirty promotion are a conservative single-version choice.
findings.required: Mandatory reservation and packet/credit completion stay Base-only with bound128; no capacity256 substitution in mandatory guards or completion CAM. Ext never WB_STAGED/INFLIGHT. Payload1168/4BankP1 and real same-bank landing remain unchanged; no private Victim Data Array or extra data copy/bandwidth.

findings.boundary: If mode1 short-circuits empty Ext and has legacy miss timing, rename it default-off golden and do not call it segmentation cost control. No new scientific request or starts are made by this review.
findings.finding: GEMM legacy / segmented-disabled / enabled can distinguish segmentation overhead and enabling benefit only if mode1 really preserves mode2 hardware/two-stage miss timing. Stencil legacy/enabled is a net resource/performance contrast.
findings.required: All new points on same new Source/ELF, exact same input/clock/Tag/Data and other configs; historical Source78/other ELF is context, not an accepted new baseline. Declare legacy extraMetadata0 versus segmented128; fixed Data is not equal total hardware cost.
findings.topic: Three-point cost control and two-point net comparison
